name: Platform Logic naming schema -- one grammar for every resource, key and principal name, so two seats mint the same conforming name and one pattern matches each firm
description: D14's naming-schema brief, the first of Andrew's two Platform Logic briefs commissioned ~03:2xZ 2026-09-13.
